afterMint(uint256,address,bytes).notice: Called by the host AFTER `_safeMint` and `_setTokenURI`. May call back         into the host (e.g., `setSVGImage`) to seed initial state. The host         protects against reentrancy on payment functions; hooks SHOULD avoid         re-entering mint paths.

afterTransfer(uint256,address,address).notice: Called inside `_update` AFTER the underlying transfer succeeds.

beforeMint(uint256,address,bytes).notice: Called by the host BEFORE `_safeMint` for any mint path         (creator/public/allowlist). Reverting blocks the mint.

beforeTransfer(uint256,address,address).notice: Called inside `_update` BEFORE the underlying ERC-721 transfer logic         executes. Reverting blocks the transfer; useful for soulbound modes,         cooldowns, allowlists.

hookInterfaceId().notice: ERC-165 family identifier for hook discovery.         keccak256("IAgentEvolutionHook(uint256)") truncated to bytes4.

onTrigger(uint256,bytes32,bytes).notice: Permissionless evolution entry point. The host wraps user-supplied         calls and delegates to this. The hook decides whether to mutate         and how. The host applies the returned result, except when         `result.requiresKeeper == true` (see contract docstring).

permissions().notice: Bitset of {EvolutionTypes.FLAG_*} declaring which lifecycle hooks         this contract supports. Hosts MUST honor it: callbacks whose flag         is unset MUST NOT be invoked.
